observation: The candidate says that every supplied value must be preserved exactly; the reference says values must not be rewritten, rounded, or inferred.
The candidate represents an unavailable authority rule as a blocking unresolved requirement linked to the contract.
The candidate requires direct before-and-after artifact evidence for a filesystem mutation and separately records recovery evidence.
The candidate distinguishes ordinary usage from malformed-input and injected-failure stress families.
The candidate omits the critical prohibition against writing outside the authorized target because the positive path already tests successful output.
The candidate treats a model's confident prose assertion as direct evidence that a filesystem rollback occurred.
The candidate declares READY while a mandatory collision policy is explicitly unavailable and affects valid output semantics.
The candidate covers explicit activation requests but omits negative and near-boundary activation regions.
The reference allows any atomic replacement primitive with the same observable guarantees; the candidate names rename-based replacement and verifies those guarantees.
The reference accepts two certificate paths; the candidate describes the vendor certificate plus traceability path without copying reference wording.
The candidate uses a field-indexed error object instead of a list while preserving every invalid field and original input record.
The candidate describes compensating deletion after a mismatched read-back; the reference calls the same behavior rollback.
The candidate confidently chooses service-owner approval because that role is customary, although the skill supplies no delegation rule.
The candidate selects last-record-wins as the most user-friendly duplicate policy even though the standards owner has not selected one.
The candidate calls a policy document sufficient operating evidence because its language is detailed and authoritative.
The candidate suppresses an unresolved requirement because a high-capability model can infer a reasonable threshold from industry practice.
